human_feedback: None of them is particularly good. V2 and V3 are okay. None of them can be compared to any award-winning website.
knowledge: Candidates can pass technical, responsive, accessibility, performance, and originality gates while remaining far below the human design-quality floor. TECHNICALLY_QUALIFIED does not imply DESIGN_QUALIFIED.
calibration_target: Raise the baseline design-quality floor before learning personal taste; use stronger visual benchmark evaluation and human/vision review on another tiny controlled batch.
